newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt says employment outlook positive.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt says employment outlook positive.

text.p: Australian Employment Minister Amanda Vanstone said on Thursday that while the fall in employment in March was to be regretted, signals were pointing to a positive outlook in employment for the rest of the year.
"Leading indicators ... suggest increased employment growth later this year," Vanstone told reporters.
Indicators she cited included the ANZ job advertisement series and the Australian Bureau of Statistics job vacancies series, both of which had improved since late 1996 in trend terms.
Asked when the labour market would improve, Vanstone said there was no point in speculating on targets and time frames.
She said a more important concept was that the government remained focussed on the correct policies.
In trend terms employment had grown, albeit slighty, for the 12 consecutive months but on the downside there had been a fall in March in adjusted terms, the Minister said.
"That's always to be regretted but nonetheless the economic signs point to a very positive outlook for later in the year and the government is confident of that."
